source._comment: LIVE via the UF Election Lab stand-in, 2026-10-20 (Sam: 'arkansas is now reporting data'). Re-checked sos.arkansas.gov/elections, /elections/voter-information, /news (press releases): still no early-vote page, dashboard or file (the SoS's day-1 figure, 56,950 in-person voters in all but four counties, was announced to the press). By statute county boards report early/absentee counts officially only after the polls close (Ark. Code 7-5-416(a)(7)(B), 7-5-701). The SoS shares daily county counts with the Election Lab: election.lab.ufl.edu/data-downloads/earlyvote/2026/US.csv row AR (data_source 'Arkansas Secretary of State', last_update 10/20/2026) and AR_county.csv (73 counties, summing exactly to the statewide row). Early voting Oct 19 - Nov 2 (not Sundays). If the SoS starts posting its own file, wire it in ar_update.fetch_counties() and it replaces the stand-in.
source._standin: scripts/lab_standin.py (US.csv + AR_county.csv), unaltered, attributed, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; turnout-only (the Lab's AR party columns are mostly 'none': Arkansas records only which party's primary ballot a voter took).
